questions.explanation: Cost may be similar or lower, but cost is not the primary sustainability reason. In-situ = communities stay; vendors retain customers, artisans retain client bases, school/clinic access continuous, social networks intact. Relocation dislocates all of this, often causing economic collapse and family dissolution. In-situ requires MORE community participation typically (SHFC-CMP model). In-situ upgrading (via CMP) actually formalizes tenure. In-situ = communities stay; vendors retain customers, artisans retain client bases, school/clinic access continuous, social networks intact. Relocation dislocates all of this, often causing economic collapse and family dissolution. In-situ strength: community continuity + livelihood preservation + social stability.
